detail.title: H530 Multi-Platform Gaming Headset - Black/Red
detail.overview: The Ant Esports H530 is a multi-platform gaming headset built around 40mm neodymium drivers tuned for both bass response and spatial awareness, giving a genuine edge in competitive titles. Double-padded headbands reduce head pressure across different head shapes, while soft, breathable leatherette earmuffs isolate outside noise effectively for long, fatigue-free gaming sessions. A unidirectional noise-cancellation boom microphone transmits voice clearly even in noisy environments, and a lightweight metal-and-fabric headband construction keeps the whole headset comfortable to wear for hours. Broad compatibility spans PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, Android and iOS, making the H530 a flexible choice across almost any gaming setup.
